what_happened: Every structural risk was machine-checked sorry-free during research via lean_run_code: the NomicFrame structure (one carrier + derived family NomicFrame.at + IsRegular class + instance), lawHist/HF, the WorldHistory bridge, the three properties with Uniform->Static and Uniform->Lawful, lem:nomic-occurrence, a general two-point-history lemma over TaskFrame, the FULL lem:nomic-recovery biconditional (all three duration cases), ofStepFamily over Z with at_eq by rfl and auto-regularity, mem_lawHist_ofStepFamily_iff, a stepPath_invariant helper, and witness 1 (static-not-lawful) complete. Implementation can transcribe verified proof text.

'at' is a reserved token in Lean 4: 'def at (F : NomicFrame D) ...' inside 'namespace NomicFrame' fails to parse with 'unexpected token at; expected identifier'. The dotted form 'def NomicFrame.at ...' declared OUTSIDE the namespace parses, and 'F.at w' works everywhere in terms. Recorded so the plan does not rediscover it.

scripts/check-paper-definitions.sh is ALREADY RED before this task: 26 recorded anchors drifted (thm:exist, lem:uniq and 24 others gained bracketed environment titles etc). Pre-existing and unrelated; this task must not treat it as its own regression and must not try to absorb the wave.

Two files this task must touch are inside concurrent task 756's declared file_scope: docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md (six new nomic anchor rows, needed for gate C15) and FormalSystem/Semantics.lean (one import line for the new aggregator). Both are append-only single-hunk edits; implementation must re-read immediately before editing and stage only its own hunks.

Planning was almost pure sequencing: the research report had already compiled, sorry-free, the frame layer, the two-point-history lemma, the full lem:nomic-recovery biconditional, the ofStepFamily presentation with its rfl bridge, the step-path invariant helper and witness 1 of prop:nomic-hierarchy. Only three declarations in the whole plan (stepPath_forward_invariant, witness 2, witness 3) are uncompiled proof work, so phase sizing could be driven by verified evidence instead of guesswork.

Two files this task must touch sit in concurrent task 789's declared file_scope: the generated library root FormalSystem.lean (regenerated by mk_all in every file-adding phase) and FormalSystem/Semantics.lean (one import line plus one docstring bullet), with FormalSystem/Semantics/README.md a third, non-gated case. The research report attributed the collision to task 756 and named docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md, but 756 has completed and that record file is in no live sibling's scope; the live collision is 789's. Plan records a per-phase protocol (re-read immediately before edit and before commit, explicit-path staging, inspect git diff of the regenerated root and stop on a foreign import line) rather than deferring the root regeneration, because a module absent from the generated root is not built by lake build FormalSystem and the phase-end greenness check would be vacuous.

Phase 1's frame layer compiled first try: the research report's R1-R4 blocks had been probe-compiled against the built project, so transcription needed only the recorded 100-column reflow. Scoped build green in one pass.

Plan Phase 1 hypothesised six new KNOWN-ANCHORS rows for docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md; lem:nomic-occurrence already carried a LIVE-UNPINNED row from an earlier task's nomic forward pointer. Added five rows and updated that one's NOT FORMALIZED note in place, as the phase's own Scope Hypothesis instructed.

Research report R6 was probe-compiled as a flat snippet with the two-point lemma in scope unqualified; the delivered Recovery.lean states it in namespace PartialHistory and consumes it from namespace NomicFrame, so the call needed a PartialHistory. qualifier. One failed scoped build, fixed in one edit, no proof content changed.

Plan Phase 3 specified Int.le_induction for stepPath_forward_invariant; that alias is deprecated on this Lean pin (warning: Use Int.leInduction instead) and a deprecation warning would trip C16/C28. Swapped to Int.leInduction, same base/succ case names, rebuild clean with zero warnings.

rw across a derived frame's carrier bit a third time, in F3_not_uniform: rw [h W3.a] on a Uniform hypothesis is refused because the membership binder is the temporal order's carrier while the path is a bare ZZ -> W3 function. The plan had recorded this hazard for mem_lawHist_ofStepFamily_iff only; it generalises to every rewrite whose pattern crosses that boundary. Set.ext_iff closes the step up to defeq.

Phase 4's Scope Hypothesis held exactly: witness 1 transcribed from the probe-compiled R9 block and built clean on the first attempt, and witness 3 as its structural mirror needed one edit. Writing both relation families as a match with a shared catch-all made the paper's two law-history coincidences rfl rather than proofs.
